ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the town is represented by a grid, mainly located in the middle-right; place ② is located on the southwest side outside the urban grid, close to the position marked "A" in the figure. The question stem states that a steel plant has already been built at place A. Then reason: In the production process, a steel plant will produce by-products such as blast furnace slag, and a cement plant can use these slags as raw materials; laying out a cement plant at place ② close to the steel plant can reduce transportation costs and is beneficial to comprehensive utilization of waste slag. At the same time, a cement plant has dust pollution, so being located outside the urban area is also relatively reasonable. Therefore, place ② should be planned as a cement plant.
